@graph.name: RAQAMORA
@graph.operatingSystem: All (Web, Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux)
@graph.description: Premium personal finance application for Pakistan. Track income, expenses, lends & borrowings across Cash, Bank, Easypaisa & JazzCash with person-wise ledgers, offline capability, and paisa-perfect arithmetic.
featureList: Easypaisa, JazzCash, and Pakistani Bank support
Offline PWA Support with automatic background live sync
Person-wise Udhaar and Khata ledger management
Category budgets and automatic 80% warning alerts
Savings goals and recurring payment scheduling
